citation.title: Model-based real-time plasma electron density profile estimation and control on ASDEX Upgrade and TCV
citation.authors: T.C. Blanken, F. Felici, C. Galperti, O. Kudláček, F. Janky, A. Mlynek, L. Giannone, P.T. Lang, W. Treutterer, W.P.M.H. Heemels, M.R. de Baar

topic: Real-time Extended Kalman filter estimation of electron density profiles, with diagnostic fault handling and feedback control, on AUG and TCV
own_question: Can a model-based observer merge multiple density diagnostics, handle faults such as fringe jumps and invalid signals, and supply controlled quantities in experiments?
actual_method_and_evidence: Uses the RAPDENS physics-based transport model inside an EKF. Interferometer, Bremsstrahlung and V1 forward models are used. Invalid channels are excluded through a selection matrix, and an FIR-based fringe-jump detector is applied. Real-time estimates are compared qualitatively with offline Thomson scattering in a few discharges. The paper reports false jump detections, underestimation of edge density, and no tracking of pellet transients. An H-infinity-tuned PI controller is used for TCV gas control. The target is electron density, not ion or impurity temperature. It is not a nowcast of delayed reports.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Recursive Bayesian/Kalman observers have been used in real time to merge diagnostics with a dynamic model and to exclude invalid channels for electron density estimation.
claim_checks.qualification: Covers electron density on AUG/TCV only; the estimator is a model-based filter, not a data-driven nowcaster. Agreement with Thomson scattering is shown qualitatively, with no quantitative error metrics.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Diagnostic faults and fast transients can corrupt real-time inputs, which motivates fault-aware estimation for control.
claim_checks.qualification: Faults discussed are interferometer fringe jumps and ICRH interference, not CES report latency.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Measurements are used at the 1.5 ms (AUG) and 1 ms (TCV) control cycle. The estimated quantity is the current electron density state. Report arrival delays are not studied.
validation_if_relevant: Qualitative comparison with offline Thomson scattering on a few discharges (#34188, #34114, #54769, #55117). There is no held-out split and no quantitative error statistics.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite as ion, impurity or CES temperature estimation.
Do not cite as evidence that our BES/ECEI estimator works or meets 10 ms.
Do not claim the observer is validated against independent truth or that it is generally accurate.
Do not imply all prior real-time estimation is model-based or electrons-only.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Useful background for real-time recursive estimation, multi-diagnostic merging and validity handling in tokamak control. It is not a comparator for our task.
